name: patenta
description: Search published patents by meaning to find prior art for an invention.

interface.longDescription:
Search patents, find prior art, or check whether an idea already exists. Patenta is a semantic patent search: it matches published patents by meaning rather than by keyword. Describe an invention or technical idea in plain language and get the closest matching patents.

For patent work, use it for a prior-art or novelty search before filing an application, or to see whether a product idea or technical solution has already been patented. In research and development, use it to see what already exists before a project starts, to find earlier solutions to a technical problem, and to see which companies are active in a field. It suits inventors, founders, engineers, scientists, R&D teams and patent professionals who want a first look at the patents around an idea.
defaultPrompt: Has anyone patented a bike lock that unlocks with a fingerprint and alerts my phone if it is cut?
Find US patents similar to a foldable drone frame with self-locking arms.
What prior art exists for a toothbrush that vibrates when I brush too hard?

positive.description: Check whether an idea already exists
positive.prompt: Has anyone patented a bicycle lock that unlocks with a fingerprint sensor and sends a phone alert if the cable is cut?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns related patents with publication number, title, assignee, date and link, and explains how the closest ones overlap with the idea.

positive.description: Limit the search to one patent office
positive.prompt: Find US patents about noise-cancelling headphones that adapt to how well the ear cup fits.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with country set to US and returns only US publications.

positive.prompt: Which patents from the last 5 years cover a drone that inspects wind turbine blades with thermal imaging?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs one search over the full history and reports the matching patents published in the last 5 years, picked from the results by their dates. If none are that recent, says so and names the closest older ones.

positive.description: Ask for a set number of results
positive.prompt: Show me 20 patents similar to a self-watering plant pot with a wick and a water-level indicator.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 20 related patents, closest match first.

positive.prompt: I want to patent a toothbrush with pressure sensors that vibrates when I brush too hard. What prior art exists?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the closest existing patents, summarizes the overlap, and notes that this is a screening search and not legal advice.

negative.description: Legal status and ownership of a known patent
negative.prompt: What is the current legal status of US10000000B2 and who owns it now?
Is the name Lumina available as a trademark for skincare in the EU?
Write the claims for my patent application and file it with the USPTO for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
